answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. A vault of per-task receipts records who did what, and the grove of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
